task_description.overview: Perform network-based coincidence triggering on multiple station streams to identify local seismic events.
steps: Assemble a Stream of multiple station Traces.
Optionally apply a bandpass filter to all traces.
Invoke coincidence_trigger(method, on_threshold, off_threshold, stream, min_coincidence, sta, lta).
Parse returned list of events with time, duration, stations and trace_ids.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Given a list of traces {stream}, apply a {filter.type} filter between {filter.freqmin} and {filter.freqmax} Hz. Run coincidence_trigger with parameters {coincidence_trigger_param}. Plot a figure to show the waveform, the coincidence trigger caculated result, and the finally picked onset and offset times. Save the coincidence trigger result into a json file {result_data.file_name} with content {result_data.file_content}. Save the figure to {coincidence_trigger_result}.
